title: Comparing Your Real Options for The COREMERCH Sovereign Stack Deployment Guide
author: COREMERCH
excerpt: No KYC. No platform risk. No dependency. Revenue flows to a wallet you control. The infrastructure layer that makes platforms optional.

content.text: Nigerian ebook creators, Ghanaian course sellers, and Kenyan digital product entrepreneurs – you're not alone in facing payment restrictions. Stripe and PayPal have suspended creators in your region, freezing their funds and crippling their businesses. The reality is harsh: no access to conventional payment platforms means no revenue for you. But there's a better way – a sovereign commerce infrastructure that puts you in control, without relying on Stripe or PayPal. Let's compare your real options for deploying the COREMERCH Sovereign Stack.
What Each Option Actually Offers

The COREMERCH Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) gives you a GitHub Pages-hosted store, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) upgrades to Cloudflare Pages, Supabase, and SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration. Meanwhile, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, empowering you to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. But what truly sets COREMERCH apart is its commitment to infrastructure sovereignty – no dependencies on Stripe, PayPal, or any other platform.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Restricted countries? No problem. COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure is built to thrive in regions where Stripe and PayPal are unavailable or restricted. By leveraging free tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, and Supabase, you can deploy a fully functional store without relying on conventional payment platforms. This means no KYC requirements, no buyer account restrictions, and no risk of platform suspension. You're free to focus on selling your ebooks, courses, and digital products without worrying about payment gatekeepers.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Fast payment processing is essential for digital creators. With COREMERCH, you can enjoy automatic on-chain crypto payment verification through NOWPayments, with fees as low as 0.5%. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON, with transaction costs under $0.10. Compare this to the 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction fees charged by Stripe and PayPal – a significant difference that can make or break your business.
COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure is built to thrive in regions where Stripe and PayPal are unavailable or restricted.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

True ownership means you control every aspect of your digital commerce stack. With COREMERCH, you have complete access to your store's source code, customer list, order history, product files, and wallet addresses. Automate your store's backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and deliver your products via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. No dependencies, no subscriptions, and no risk of platform suspension – just pure infrastructure sovereignty.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Your architecture choice depends on your business needs. If you're a solo creator, the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) is a great starting point. For more complex stores, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers advanced features and configuration. Meanwhile, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides the ultimate solution for scaling your digital commerce business. With this comprehensive toolkit, you'll have everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack – instant download available.
What does sovereign commerce infrastructure mean for digital creators?

What does sovereign commerce infrastructure mean for digital creators? It means taking control of your store's infrastructure, without relying on Stripe or PayPal. By choosing COREMERCH, you're not just building a store – you're building a business that's resistant to platform suspension and payment restrictions. With true ownership, automation, and delivery, you can focus on selling your digital products without worrying about payment gatekeepers."
